children.text: Pinehaven is a small collection of cabins in the pines above the lake. We keep it quiet on purpose: four cabins, plenty of space between them, and time for what matters most.

Each cabin has its own character, from the Ridge Cabin high above the valley to the Lakeside Cabin a few minutes from the shore. Send us your dates and we’ll reply personally with availability and details.

data.title: The Ridge Cabin
data.tagline: Ridge views. Open plan. Room to gather.
data.summary: Perched above the trees with sweeping mountain views, the Ridge Cabin offers space, light and a front-row seat to nature’s beauty.
data.intro: Our largest cabin sits high on the ridge, with two king bedrooms, a vaulted great room and a deck that looks straight across the valley.
data.overview_title: Space to gather above the trees.
data.overview: The Ridge Cabin is made for two couples or a small family who want room to spread out. A vaulted great room opens onto a wide deck, the kitchen is set up for long dinners, and both bedrooms wake up to the mountains.
data.location: At the top of the lodge road, a short walk from the main lodge. The last stretch is a gravel track; most cars manage it year-round.
data.photo_alt: A timber cabin with glowing windows among tall pines at dusk
data.interior_alt: A king bed in a timber-panelled bedroom with a window onto the mountains at sunset

data.title: The Meadow Cabin
data.tagline: Meadow light. Warm timber. Quiet for two.
data.summary: A warm and intimate retreat with expansive windows that frame the forest and meadow beyond. Perfect for couples seeking a quiet escape.
data.intro: A one-bedroom hideaway at the edge of the meadow, with a king bed facing the forest and a reading chair by the window.
data.overview_title: A quiet room with a view.
data.overview: The Meadow Cabin is our smallest and most private stay. Floor-to-ceiling glass frames the meadow and the hills beyond, and evenings are for lamplight, a good book and the sound of the forest.
data.location: On the meadow path, a five-minute walk from the main lodge. Parking is beside the cabin.
data.photo_alt: A lamplit bedroom with a king bed and a wall of glass looking onto pines and hills
data.interior_alt: A lamplit bedroom with a king bed and a wall of glass looking onto pines and hills

data.title: The Lakeside Cabin
data.tagline: Lake air. Stone and timber. Slow mornings.
data.summary: Set closer to the water, the Lakeside Cabin blends rustic charm with refined comfort, offering an immersive connection to the lake and surrounding forest.
data.intro: A stone-and-timber cabin on the slope above the lake, with a king bedroom, a porch for slow mornings and the water a short walk away.
data.overview: The Lakeside Cabin sits on the rocky slope above the shore. Mornings start on the porch with the lake below, and a trail leads down to the water and the breakfast café along the bay.
data.location: On the lower slope, about ten minutes on foot from the main lodge and three minutes from the shore.
data.photo_alt: A stone and timber cabin on a rocky slope above a lake and pine forest at sunset
data.interior_alt: A stone and timber cabin on a rocky slope above a lake and pine forest at sunset

data.title: The Pine Cabin
data.tagline: Forest views. Modern comfort. Time well spent.
data.summary: Surrounded by towering pines, with a stone fireplace, a fire-pit deck and room for a family or two couples.
data.intro: A secluded cabin surrounded by towering pines, with expansive views, a stone fireplace, and thoughtful details for a restful stay.
data.overview_title: A private retreat in the pines.
data.overview: The Pine Cabin blends rustic charm with modern comfort, offering a peaceful escape in the heart of nature. Enjoy morning coffee on the deck, evenings by the fire, and sweeping mountain and lake views throughout your stay.

amenities.name: Deck with fire pit and lounge seating

data.location: In the pine grove below the main lodge, a five-minute walk along a lit path. Lakeside Breakfast is a 20-minute drive and Willow Creek Village 30 minutes.

Pine Ridge Trail
data.summary: A scenic trail through forested slopes with panoramic views of the valley.
data.details: The trail starts behind the main lodge and climbs gently through the pines to a rocky lookout over the lake. Go early for soft light and quiet, and come back the same way or loop down past the Lakeside Cabin.
data.good_to_know: Moderate. Good shoes and water; trail map at the lodge.
data.photo_alt: A hiker with a backpack on a forest trail with snow-capped peaks and a lake ahead

data.title: Lakeside Breakfast
data.summary: Enjoy fresh, local fare at a beloved lakeside café with mountain views.
data.details: A small café on the water serving waffles with berries, eggs from nearby farms and strong coffee. Ask for a table on the deck when the morning is clear.
data.good_to_know: Open for breakfast and lunch; busiest on weekends.
data.photo_alt: Coffee and waffles with fresh berries on a wooden table by a lake with mountains behind

data.title: Willow Creek Village
data.summary: A charming mountain town with unique shops, art galleries and local restaurants.
data.details: A main street of timber storefronts, a general store, galleries and a handful of good restaurants. Make an afternoon of it and drive back along the lake road at sunset.
data.good_to_know: Street parking along Main Street; most shops close by 6 pm.
data.photo_alt: A mountain village main street with timber storefronts, flower baskets and a general store
